text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute got injured during training,
so I rushed her to the infirmary
as fast as I could.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ow, ow, ow...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd be able to
hold out just a little longer, though.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, miscalculating means I'm still green...
That said, I've still got stamina to spare.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, what would you say to some light
exercise, strictly for rehabilitation purposes?"
choice_data_list: Right this second is still too early.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...I figured you'd say that.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I suppose it can't be helped.
If you push yourself and make the injury worse,
it'd truly be disastrous...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I suppose so.
Guess I'll take a rest, then..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking a bit dissatisfied,
Wonder Acute accepted the proposal.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course I know that.
It won't do any good if the injury gets worse, after all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, shall we get going?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Ouch.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
To think it hurts just to walk a little...
Guess I'd better call it a day, huh.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Nothing good comes from rushing...
This incident really taught me that all over again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite offering positive words,
Wonder Acute ended up dropping her shoulders in heavy dejection.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, shall we get going?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "I can't put on a powerful sprint, but the track feels pretty solid under my feet."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
When doing rehab, this feeling
is the best encouragement of all, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Wonder Acute persevered
and dedicated herself to training
within a reasonable limit.
